question: For Durvalumab, Tremelimumab trials, bucket the publication year into: ≤2014, 2015–2018, ≥2019.

steps.desc: Filter trials containing Durvalumab or Tremelimumab and select the publication year.
Bucket the publication year into the specified categories.
steps.sql:
SELECT 
    "NCT",
    "PMID",
    "Author",
    "Year",
    CASE
        WHEN "Year" <= 2014 THEN '≤2014'
        WHEN "Year" >= 2015 AND "Year" <= 2018 THEN '2015–2018'
        WHEN "Year" >= 2019 THEN '≥2019'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS publication_year_bucket
FROM t1
